text:
The Aldermoor hoard is now held by the Lathe Street Gallery, which took formal possession of the collection on 14 March 2024.

The transfer is set out in the Aldermoor Hoard Transfer Agreement, signed at a public ceremony at the gallery and filed with the Aldermoor County Heritage Board. Dr. Ingrid Valtanen, the gallery's Head of Collections, signed the acceptance on the gallery's behalf.

According to the inventory recorded under the agreement, the hoard comprises 312 objects. These include silver torcs, coins and brooches.

The agreement confirms that the gallery is now the institution responsible for the collection. The filing with the heritage board forms the public record of the transfer. The gallery has not been named in any other document as a co-holder of the hoard.
